KAFKA-STRIKE_KAFKA.title: Strike
KAFKA-DEFEND_KAFKA.title: Defend
KAFKA-LIGHTNING_TOUCH.title: Lightning Touch
KAFKA-LIGHTNING_TOUCH.description:
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, 3 turns). Gain Block equal to target's [gold]Shock[/gold] stack count.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Gain Block again.
KAFKA-SUMMON_THUNDER_SHADOW.title: Caressing Moonlight
KAFKA-SUMMON_THUNDER_SHADOW.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, 2 turns) to ALL enemies.
KAFKA-ARC_BOLT.title: Arc Bolt
KAFKA-ARC_BOLT.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage per [gold]Shock[/gold] on target.
KAFKA-WHISPER.title: Whisper
KAFKA-WHISPER.description: Copy the highest damage [gold]Shock[/gold] on target {CopyCount:diff()} time(s).
KAFKA-CHAIN_LIGHTNING.title: Chain Lightning
KAFKA-CHAIN_LIGHTNING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If target has [gold]Shock[/gold], deal the same damage to all other enemies.
KAFKA-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
KAFKA-ZAP_KAFKA.title: Nihility Night
KAFKA-PURSUIT_SLASH.title: Pursuit Slash
KAFKA-EVASIVE_STEP.title: Composed Retreat
KAFKA-EVASIVE_STEP.description:
Gain {DexAmount:diff()} temporary Dexterity this turn.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Draw 2 cards.
KAFKA-LIGHTNING_FLASH.title: Lightning Flash
KAFKA-SWIFT_THRUST.title: Swift Thrust
KAFKA-COVER_FIRE.title: Cover Fire
KAFKA-COVER_FIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Apply {DebuffStacks:diff()} Vulnerable and {DebuffStacks:diff()} Weak.
KAFKA-CHARGE_UP.title: Charge Up
KAFKA-CHARGE_UP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If target has >= 3 [gold]Shock[/gold], apply 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
KAFKA-THUNDER_FORESIGHT.title: Thunder Foresight
KAFKA-THUNDER_FORESIGHT.description: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg} dmg, {ShockTurns} turns) to ALL enemies. Draw {DrawCount:diff()} cards.
KAFKA-PRECISION_STRIKE.title: Fermata
KAFKA-PRECISION_STRIKE.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] a random enemy. Draw 1 card.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: [gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} card(s) from hand.
KAFKA-TWILIGHT_SHIELD.title: Twilight Shield
KAFKA-DOMINATION.title: Domination
KAFKA-DOMINATION.description: Whenever you play an Attack, apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, 2 turns) to a random enemy.
KAFKA-DETONATE.title: Twilight Trill
KAFKA-DETONATE.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] target.
Randomly remove 1 [gold]Shock[/gold]. All remaining [gold]Shock[/gold] gain +{ShockBoost:diff()} damage.
KAFKA-SHORT_CIRCUIT.title: Short Circuit
KAFKA-SHORT_CIRCUIT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
If target has [gold]Shock[/gold], apply {WeakTurns:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
KAFKA-MASS_DETONATION.title: Mass Detonation
KAFKA-GENTLE_BUT_CRUEL.title: Gentle but Cruel
KAFKA-GENTLE_BUT_CRUEL.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Pursuit[/gold], draw 1 card and gain 1 Block.
KAFKA-PURSUIT_DETONATION.title: Residual Echo
KAFKA-PURSUIT_DETONATION.description:
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, {ShockTurns} turns).
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Copy 1 random [gold]Shock[/gold] from target to a random enemy.
KAFKA-POWER_SIPHON.title: Energy Siphon
KAFKA-ENERGY_RELEASE.title: Energy Release
KAFKA-ENERGY_RELEASE.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] target {DetonateCount:diff()} times.
Remove all [gold]Shock[/gold] from target.
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} equal to removed [gold]Shock[/gold] count.
KAFKA-DOLOROSO.title: Doloroso
KAFKA-DOLOROSO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, {ShockTurns} turns).
If this card was created by [gold]Rewrite[/gold], all effects trigger {ExtraRepeat:diff()} extra time(s).
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: [gold]Detonate[/gold] target.
KAFKA-MERCY_IS_NOT_FORGIVENESS.title: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
KAFKA-MERCY_IS_NOT_FORGIVENESS.descripti:
[gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} card(s) from hand.
For each Attack card obtained, randomly [gold]Detonate[/gold] an enemy.
KAFKA-BIDE.title: Bide
KAFKA-BIDE.description:
Strengthen all [gold]Shock[/gold] on target by +{StrengthAmount:diff()} damage.
Extend all [gold]Shock[/gold] on target by {ExtendTurns} turn(s).
KAFKA-RAPID_FIRE.title: Rapid Fire
KAFKA-RAPID_FIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
Each hit applies [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, {ShockTurns} turns).
KAFKA-SPIRIT_WHISPER.title: Spirit Whisper
KAFKA-SPIRIT_WHISPER.description: At the start of your turn, add a random Attack card to your hand. It costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} this turn.
KAFKA-GALE_SLASH.title: Gale Slash
KAFKA-AGILE_MOVEMENT.title: Agile Movement
KAFKA-TACTICAL_COVER.title: Tactical Cover
KAFKA-TACTICAL_COVER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Strengthen all [gold]Shock[/gold] on target by +{StrengthAmount:diff()}.
KAFKA-TWILIGHT_STEP.title: Twilight Step
KAFKA-SURGE.title: Surge
KAFKA-SURGE.description: Randomly remove one [gold]Shock[/gold] from each enemy. If any removed, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
KAFKA-DUSK_ARMOR.title: Starlight Armor
KAFKA-DUSK_ARMOR.description: Gain Block equal to target's total [gold]Shock[/gold] damage.
KAFKA-INSIGHT.title: Insight
KAFKA-INSIGHT.description:
Draw {DrawCount:diff()} cards.
When this card is [gold]Rewritten[/gold]: draw until hand limit.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Gain {PursuitBlock:diff()} Block.
KAFKA-NIGHTFALL.title: Nightfall
KAFKA-NIGHTFALL.description: Extend all [gold]Shock[/gold] on all enemies by +{ExtendTurns:diff()} turns.
KAFKA-HUNTERS_INSTINCT.title: Hunter's Instinct
KAFKA-HUNTERS_INSTINCT.description:
Remove {RemoveCount:diff()} random [gold]Shock[/gold] from target.
Copy all remaining [gold]Shock[/gold] on target.
KAFKA-PROPAGATION.title: Propagation
KAFKA-PROPAGATION.description: Copy all [gold]Shock[/gold] on target to all other enemies.
KAFKA-THUNDERCLAP_KAFKA.title: Thunderclap
KAFKA-THUNDERCLAP_KAFKA.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Copy all [gold]Shock[/gold] on all enemies.
Remove {RemoveCount:diff()} random [gold]Shock[/gold] from each enemy.
KAFKA-EM_PULSE.title: EM Pulse
KAFKA-EM_PULSE.description:
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, {ShockTurns} turns) to ALL enemies.
Double damage for enemies with <= 2 [gold]Shock[/gold].
KAFKA-NIHILITY_BLADE.title: Nihility Blade
KAFKA-NIHILITY_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: All [gold]Shock[/gold] on target +{ShockBoost:diff()} damage and +1 turn.
KAFKA-CHARGED_STRIKE.title: Whimper
KAFKA-CHARGED_STRIKE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
When this card is [gold]Rewritten[/gold]: randomly [gold]Detonate[/gold] an enemy.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Draw 1 card for each [gold]Rewritten[/gold] card in hand.
KAFKA-DA_CAPO.title: Da Capo
KAFKA-DA_CAPO.description: This turn, all [gold]Pursuit[/gold] cards trigger effects regardless of conditions.
KAFKA-ETERNAL_MIDNIGHT.title: Eternal Midnight
KAFKA-ETERNAL_MIDNIGHT.description: At the end of your turn, [gold]Detonate[/gold] all enemies.
KAFKA-FORTISSISSIMO.title: Fortississimo
KAFKA-CAPRICCIO.title: Capriccio
KAFKA-CAPRICCIO.description: This turn, whenever you draw a card, apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg} dmg/turn, {ShockTurns} turns) to a random enemy.
KAFKA-CHAIN_DETONATION.title: Chain Detonation
KAFKA-LEGGIERO.title: Leggiero
KAFKA-LEGGIERO.description: At the start of your turn, remove a random [gold]Shock[/gold] from each enemy. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
KAFKA-ENDLESS_PURSUIT.title: Endless Pursuit
KAFKA-ENDLESS_PURSUIT.description: Whenever you trigger [gold]Pursuit[/gold], deal {AoeDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
KAFKA-AGENTS_CREED.title: Agent's Creed
KAFKA-AGENTS_CREED.description: Each [gold]Detonate[/gold] has a 33% chance to trigger an extra [gold]Detonate[/gold].
KAFKA-ASSASSINATE_KAFKA.title: Assassinate
KAFKA-RECITATIVO.title: Aria
KAFKA-RECITATIVO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, {ShockTurns} turns) to ALL.
KAFKA-PERFECT_RHYTHM.title: Perfect Rhythm
KAFKA-PERFECT_RHYTHM.description: Whenever you [gold]Detonate[/gold], increase all [gold]Shock[/gold] damage on the detonated target by {ShockBonus:diff()}.
KAFKA-LIGHTNING_AGENT.title: Lightning Agent
KAFKA-LIGHTNING_AGENT.description: Each turn, the first time you apply [gold]Shock[/gold], apply it an additional time.
KAFKA-SLAVE_OF_DESTINY.title: Slave of Destiny
KAFKA-SLAVE_OF_DESTINY.description: Strengthen all [gold]Shock[/gold] on all enemies by +{StrengthAmount:diff()}, then [gold]Detonate[/gold] all enemies.
KAFKA-STELLARON_RESONANCE.title: Stellaron Resonance
KAFKA-STELLARON_RESONANCE.description: At end of turn, strengthen all [gold]Shock[/gold] on all enemies by +{StrengthAmount:diff()}.
KAFKA-MOONLIT_HUNT.title: Moonlit Hunt
KAFKA-MOONLIT_HUNT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times.
Each hit [gold]Detonate[/gold]s target.
KAFKA-NIHILITY_DOMINION.title: Nihility Dominion
KAFKA-NIHILITY_DOMINION.description: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, {ShockTurns:diff()} turns) to ALL enemies, repeated X times.
KAFKA-HEART_OF_KAFKA.title: Heart of Kafka
KAFKA-HEART_OF_KAFKA.description:
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, {ShockTurns} turns) to ALL enemies.
[gold]Detonate[/gold] all enemies.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Generate a random Power card and play it for free.
KAFKA-TRILL_OF_DESTINY.title: Trill of Destiny
KAFKA-TRILL_OF_DESTINY.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, 2 turns) to ALL enemies. [gold]Detonate[/gold] all.
KAFKA-FLANKING_KAFKA.title: Flanking
KAFKA-FLANKING_KAFKA.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
Randomly return a card from your discard pile to your hand.
KAFKA-LETHAL_COMBO.title: Lethal Combo
KAFKA-LETHAL_COMBO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Draw and auto-play the top {AutoPlayCount:diff()} card(s) from draw pile.
KAFKA-THREAD_OF_FATE.title: Thread of Fate
KAFKA-THREAD_OF_FATE.description:
Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, {ShockTurns} turns).
Reduce target's Strength by number of [gold]Shock[/gold] stacks (restores after 1 turn).
KAFKA-FATE_REWRITE.title: Fate Rewrite
KAFKA-FATE_REWRITE.description: Select and [gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} card(s) in your hand.
KAFKA-TAMPERED_STRIKE.title: Tampered Strike
KAFKA-TAMPERED_STRIKE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Randomly [gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} cards in your hand.
KAFKA-DEEP_REWRITE.title: Deep Rewrite
KAFKA-DEEP_REWRITE.description:
Select a card from your hand and [gold]Rewrite[/gold] it.
The rewritten card costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} this turn.
KAFKA-SCRIPT_REVISION.title: Script Revision
KAFKA-DISCARD_TAMPERING.title: Tonight's Sonata
KAFKA-DISCARD_TAMPERING.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Randomly [gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} cards in your discard pile.
KAFKA-FATE_MANIPULATION.title: Fate Manipulation
KAFKA-FATE_MANIPULATION.description: Whenever you [gold]Rewrite[/gold] a card, apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg/turn, 2 turns) to a random enemy.
KAFKA-BLADE_OF_TAMPERING.title: Blade of Tampering
KAFKA-BLADE_OF_TAMPERING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Rewrite[/gold] a card from your hand.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: The rewritten card costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} this turn.
KAFKA-TOTAL_REWRITE.title: Just Wait
KAFKA-TOTAL_REWRITE.description: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, 2 turns) to random enemies, once per [gold]Rewritten[/gold] card in hand +{BaseCount:diff()}.
KAFKA-SCRIPT_HIJACK.title: Script Hijack
KAFKA-SCRIPT_HIJACK.description: The first time you trigger [gold]Pursuit[/gold] each turn, randomly [gold]Rewrite[/gold] {RewriteCount:diff()} card(s) in your draw pile.
KAFKA-HARMONIC_RESONANCE.title: Harmonic Resonance
KAFKA-HARMONIC_RESONANCE.description:
[gold]Detonate[/gold] target.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Copy target's highest damage [gold]Shock[/gold] {CopyCount:diff()} time(s).
KAFKA-WHEEL_OF_FATE.title: Wheel of Fate
KAFKA-WHEEL_OF_FATE.description:
Random effect:
A. ALL [gold]Shock[/gold]({ShockDmg:diff()},2t)
B. +{Energy:energyIcons()}, draw 3
C. Lose all Block at end of turn
KAFKA-DESTINED_FUTURE.title: Destined Future
KAFKA-DESTINED_FUTURE.description:
Random effect:
A. [gold]Detonate[/gold] random enemy x2
B. [gold]Rewrite[/gold] all hand Atk/Skill
C. Apply 1 Vulnerable + 1 Weak to self
KAFKA-IMPROVISATION.title: Improvisation
KAFKA-IMPROVISATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Random:
A. +{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, draw {DrawCount:diff()}
B. +{Block:diff()} Block
C. Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP
KAFKA-DEAD_WHISPER.title: Dead Whisper
KAFKA-DEAD_WHISPER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Randomly remove 1 [gold]Shock[/gold] from target. Gain temporary Strength equal to its damage this turn.
KAFKA-SILENT_RIDICULE.title: Silent Ridicule
KAFKA-SILENT_RIDICULE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Randomly [gold]Rewrite[/gold] 1 card in draw pile.
[gold]Pursuit[/gold]: Play the [gold]Rewritten[/gold] card.
KAFKA-STRANGE_LETTER.title: Strange Letter
KAFKA-STRANGE_LETTER.description:
Exhaust 1 [gold]Rewritten[/gold] hand card.
Skill: Apply [gold]Shock[/gold] ({ShockDmg:diff()} dmg, 2 turns) to ALL enemies.
Attack: Randomly [gold]Detonate[/gold] {DetonateCount:diff()} time(s).
KAFKA-PUPPET_ON_STRINGS.title: Puppet on Strings
KAFKA-PUPPET_ON_STRINGS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
For each [gold]Rewritten[/gold] card played this combat, deal +{BonusDmg:diff()} damage.
KAFKA-IMPROVISATION_KAFKA.title: Improvisation
KAFKA-IMPROVISATION_KAFKA.description:
Draw X+{BonusDraw:diff()} cards.
[gold]Rewrite[/gold] all drawn Attacks and Skills. They cost {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} this turn.
KAFKA-REST_NOTE.title: Rest Note
KAFKA-REST_NOTE.description: When you play a [gold]Rewritten[/gold] [gold]Pursuit[/gold] card, its Pursuit triggers 1 extra time.
KAFKA-ELIOS_BLANK.title: Elio's Blank
KAFKA-ELIOS_BLANK.description: Choose a card in hand. Add X+{BonusCopy:diff()} [gold]Rewritten[/gold] copies to your hand.
KAFKA-CURTAIN_CALL.title: Curtain Call
KAFKA-CURTAIN_CALL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
When this card is [gold]Rewritten[/gold], gain {RewriteEnergy:energyIcons()}.
KAFKA-I_PRAISE_IMPROVISE.title: I Praise, Improvise
KAFKA-I_PRAISE_IMPROVISE.description: This turn, [gold]Pursuit[/gold] effects trigger 1 extra time.
